question.sl: Ali lahko mačke jedo čili papričice?

answer.en: No, don't share chilli peppers or other spicy food with your cat. VCA Animal Hospitals says spicy foods may not be toxic to cats, but they are certain to cause stomach upset.
answer.sl: Ne, čili papričic in druge pekoče hrane ne delite z mačko. VCA Animal Hospitals navaja, da pekoča hrana za mačke morda ni strupena, zagotovo pa jim povzroči prebavne težave.
answer.pt: Não, não partilhes malaguetas nem outra comida picante com o teu gato. Os VCA Animal Hospitals dizem que a comida picante pode não ser tóxica para os gatos, mas certamente causa mal-estar no estômago.

why.en: VCA Animal Hospitals advises not to share spicy foods with your cat and to keep jalapeño poppers to yourself: spicy foods may not be toxic to cats, but they are certain to cause stomach upset. Cats don't need vegetables in their diet, and the ASPCA notes that any plant material may cause vomiting and stomach upset in cats.
why.sl: VCA Animal Hospitals svetuje, naj pekoče hrane ne delimo z mačko in naj polnjene jalapeño papričice ostanejo nam: pekoča hrana za mačke morda ni strupena, zagotovo pa jim povzroči prebavne težave. Mačke zelenjave v prehrani ne potrebujejo, ASPCA pa opozarja, da lahko vsaka rastlinska hrana pri mačkah povzroči bruhanje in želodčne težave.
why.pt: Os VCA Animal Hospitals aconselham a não partilhar comida picante com o gato e a guardar os jalapeño poppers para ti: a comida picante pode não ser tóxica para os gatos, mas certamente causa mal-estar no estômago. Os gatos não precisam de legumes na alimentação, e a ASPCA refere que qualquer matéria vegetal pode causar vómitos e mal-estar no estômago nos gatos.

what_to_do.en: If your cat ate chilli or spicy food and then vomits or has an upset stomach, contact your vet for advice. Don't try to make your cat sick without asking the vet.
what_to_do.sl: Če je mačka pojedla čili ali pekočo hrano in nato bruha ali ima prebavne težave, se za nasvet obrnite na veterinarja. Mačke ne poskušajte sami pripraviti do bruhanja, ne da bi vprašali veterinarja.
what_to_do.pt: Se o teu gato comeu malagueta ou comida picante e depois vomita ou fica com mal-estar no estômago, liga ao teu veterinário para pedir conselho. Não tentes fazer o teu gato vomitar sem perguntar ao veterinário.

child.en: Spicy chilli peppers are for people, not cats. They can give kitty a sore tummy.
child.sl: Pekoče čili papričice so za ljudi, ne za muce. Muco lahko zaboli trebušček.
child.pt: As malaguetas picantes são para as pessoas, não para os gatos. Podem dar dor de barriga ao gatinho.

sources.quote: Don't share spicy or fatty foods with your cat.
While spicy foods may not be toxic to your cat, they're certain to cause stomach upset
keep the jalapeño poppers to yourself!
they rarely eat vegetables naturally, and there is no need for you to add them to their diet.
Also, be advised that the consumption of any plant material may cause vomiting and gastrointestinal upset for dogs and cats.
Contact your veterinary team for advice immediately; make sure you know when, where, and how the poisoning occurred.
Don’t try to make your cat sick without asking the vet and never given them medicines designed for humans.
